# AgenticSystemCore

<!-- agsc:provenance

> An open specification for knowledge that people and software agents can both read, verify and build on, published here as a node of itself.

## Guides

- [Publish a Level-0 node](https://agenticsystemcore.com/procedures/publish-a-level-0-node/): Turn an existing CMS, wiki or static-site export into a conforming Level-0 node without running an engine.

## Vocabulary

- [Bundle](https://agenticsystemcore.com/concepts/bundle/): One directory tree of Markdown items plus exactly one agsc.config.json: the unit of publication and of conformance.
- [Cluster](https://agenticsystemcore.com/concepts/cluster/): A navigational grouping of items. Membership is authored on the item, and nesting is expressed as membership.
- [Concept](https://agenticsystemcore.com/concepts/concept/): A unit of knowledge in a Bundle, qualified by kind: pattern, taxonomy, explainer, principle, decision, spec, task, term or architecture.
- [Episode](https://agenticsystemcore.com/concepts/episode/): A recorded occurrence, such as a session, a run or an incident, with a start instant, an actor and an outcome.
- [Gate](https://agenticsystemcore.com/concepts/gate/): A declared set of checks that a change must pass, at level L1 or L2. Its runs are recorded as episodes.
- [Harness](https://agenticsystemcore.com/concepts/harness/): Generated output: the file map a valid composition of selected items produces. A Harness is never authored.
- [Item](https://agenticsystemcore.com/concepts/item/): One Markdown file with YAML frontmatter whose type is concept, episode, procedure, lesson, cluster or gate.
- [Lesson](https://agenticsystemcore.com/concepts/lesson/): Knowledge distilled from one or more episodes, carrying a severity of info, warn or block.
- [Link](https://agenticsystemcore.com/concepts/link/): A typed relation between two items of one Bundle, written as a frontmatter key whose values are slugs.
- [NOW](https://agenticsystemcore.com/concepts/now/): Generated context about the current state of a Bundle, such as counts and last build. NOW is never an item.
- [Procedure](https://agenticsystemcore.com/concepts/procedure/): A plan a reader can execute: a trigger, steps and checks. A procedure exports one to one to a skill file.
- [Source](https://agenticsystemcore.com/concepts/source/): An external work cited by an item, written inline as a sources[] entry and published under a fragment IRI.
